subject: Evening throughput supplement request for NovaCart preflight
messages:
From: Alex Cho <alex.cho@novacart.com>
To: laura.bennett@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 01 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Evening throughput supplement request for preflight tests

Hi Laura,

Thanks again for the demo last week. We want to run a targeted preflight over two evening windows to validate p95 latency and connection stability for our checkout flows before we go live. Specifics: 

- Window: Tue Jun 8 18:00 - Wed Jun 9 06:00 PT (two night segments)
- Target load: 1,200 reqs/sec peak, approx. 150k tokens/night (combined ~300k tokens)
- Success criteria: p95 < 120ms, no CPU OOMs, KV cache hit > 60%

Can Redwood provision an evening throughput supplement (trial/top-up credits) to cover the run and an extra 48h runway in case we need one more night for troubleshooting? Also happy to share a short runbook and telemetry endpoint for streaming traces.

We need confirmation by EOD Friday so we can lock engineering schedules.

Appreciate it —
Alex
Alex Cho
Senior SRE, NovaCart
ops@novacart.com

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Alex Cho <alex.cho@novacart.com>
Date: Mon, 01 Jun 2026 10:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Evening throughput supplement request for preflight tests

Hi Alex —

Thanks for the clear details. We can support this but I need a short plan to route internally:

1) Final expected QPS profile (10m buckets around peak)
2) Telemetry / callback URL + retention window for traces
3) Any SLA or redline you want us to accept for the run (e.g., extended support hours)

If you can drop the runbook and a one-page run schedule I will submit for a capacity/top-up approval today. Our usual approach is to provision a scoped credit bundle and require a lightweight canary for the first hour.

Will follow up with internal owners once I have those items.

Regards,
Laura Bennett
Account Exec, Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 01 Jun 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: FW: Evening throughput supplement request — NovaCart (requesting approval)

Team — forwarding NovaCart's ask. Short summary: two-night evening preflight (Jun 8–9), peak 1.2k rps, ~300k tokens total plus a requested 48h runway. They need confirmation by EOD Fri.

Why I recommend approval:
- NovaCart is in late-stage POC, high chance to convert to Dedicated capacity (deal in HubSpot: NOVA-POC-4921).
- The run will exercise our batching and prefix caching improvements; telemetry will help our Optimize team.

Proposed provision: 125,000 token credit (covers the canary + first full night) + option to enable an extra 48h pay-as-you-go buffer if we see regressions — engineering to monitor. Conditions:
- Require their telemetry callback and one-hour canary at reduced QPS.
- Limit to our evening cluster (us-west) to avoid auto-scaling cross-region exposure.

Attachments: novacart_preflight_plan.pdf (customer runbook), sla-exception-form.pdf (for signature if we extend support).

Asks: please reply with approve / adjust / deny so I can respond to the customer.

Thanks,
Laura

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: laura.bennett@redwood.com
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 02 Jun 2026 14:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: FW: Evening throughput supplement request — NovaCart (requesting approval)

Laura —

Approve with conditions:
- Provision 125,000 tokens for the specified windows (Jun 8–9). If they need the extra 48h runway, we'll enable a conditional top-up but it must be paid or approved by revenue (limit $2,000 equivalent).
- Require telemetry endpoint and that the one-hour canary clears p95 < 150ms before full ramp.
- Log the action in HubSpot (I pushed a note to the deal: https://hubspot.example.com/deal/4921).

Ben — please coordinate ops on the evening cluster allocation and ensure we set the canary throttle. Marissa — loop in CS for run-day monitoring.

Karthik
Head of Sales Engineering

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Alex Cho <alex.cho@novacart.com>, NovaCart Ops <ops@novacart.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 02 Jun 2026 15:45:00 -0700
Subject: Approved: Evening throughput supplement for NovaCart preflight (Jun 8–9)

Hi Alex —

Good news: we're able to support the Jun 8–9 evening preflight. Summary of what we approved: 

- Provisioned credit: 125,000 tokens (applied to your trial account).
- Window: Jun 8 18:00 – Jun 9 06:00 PT (primary); if you hit issues we can enable a one-time 48h buffer subject to the conditions below.
- Conditions: a one-hour canary at reduced QPS must clear p95 < 150ms; telemetry callback URL required before the run; evening cluster (us-west) allocation only.

Next steps for you:
- Reply with the telemetry callback URL and final QPS profile (10m buckets).
- Sign the attached SLA exception if you opt into extended support for the extra 48h buffer (sla-exception-form.pdf).

Attachments: novacart_preflight_plan.pdf (we have your runbook on the Drive link)

If all good, we'll push the credit and confirm the canary schedule by EOD Thu so your engineers can prepare.

Thanks — looking forward to a smooth run.

—Laura Bennett
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com
